The '''Tetan Guard''' was a division of the [[Koros fleet|Tetan fleet]], the defense force of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]]. The members of the Guard were trained to serve the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan Monarchy]], responsible for the protection of the ruling family and the [[Tetan Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. In addition to these duties, the Guard protected the entire royal bloodlines as well as the other noble families.
